Native SwiftUI iOS Hotlympics app. Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app. Firebase Auth/Storage and Google Sign-In via Swift Package Manager.

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj
After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

`App/ios_appApp.swift`: Firebase initialization, Google Sign-In URLs. Tabs: Rating, Leaderboard, Upload, My Photos, Profile. `auth/FirebaseAuthService`: OAuth, sessions, backend sync, profile/ToS. `data/ImageQueueService`: active/buffer blocks of 10, prefetch, gender filtering, auth reset. `api/RatingService`: submissions. `data/ImagePreloader`: shared 50-image NSCache. `api/UploadService`: signed URL, Firebase upload, progress, confirmation. `data/UserService`: photos/pool, five-minute cache, refresh, optimistic deletion. `Rating/`: swipe/pair UI. `Upload/`: source, camera, 400x400 crop, progress. `Photos/`: grid and pool. `Auth/`: sign-in and sequential profile setup. `shared/`: cached image view. `MyPhotosViewModel`: pool/deletion state. `UploadViewModel`: compression, progress, retries.

Rating: fetch blocks, submit winner/loser, advance and prefetch; reset on auth changes. Upload: select, crop, compress, request URL, upload, confirm, refresh cache, navigate to My Photos. Authentication: Google OAuth, Firebase credentials, backend sync, profile completion, gender/DOB then ToS.

Base URL in Constants.swift: `https://hotlympics-server-670297845147.us-central1.run.app`. API: `GET /images/block?gender={gender}&count={count}`, `POST /ratings`, `GET /leaderboards/{gender}`, `POST /images/request-upload`, `POST /images/confirm-upload/{imageId}`, `GET /images/user`, `GET /user`, `PUT /user/profile`, `POST /user/accept-tos`, `PUT /user/pool`, `DELETE /images/{imageId}`. Firebase Auth bearer token when available.

Users must complete their profile before accessing Upload, My Photos, and Profile tabs:
1. **Gender**: Must be set to "male" or "female" (not "unknown")
2. **Date of Birth**: Required for age verification (must be 18+)
3. **Terms of Service**: Must accept current version (1.0)
Incomplete profiles show ProfileSetupView; Rating and Leaderboard remain accessible. Server validates uploads. User stores identity, profile, uploaded/pool IDs, rateCount, completion properties. Use shared services, async/await, caching, optimistic updates with rollback.
